descriptionFull: The great grey shrike , northern grey shrike , or northern shrike ( Lanius excubitor ) is a large songbird species in the shrike family (Laniidae). It forms a superspecies with its parapatric southern relatives, the southern grey shrike ( L. meridionalis ), the Chinese grey shrike ( L. sphenocerus ) and the loggerhead shrike ( L. ludovicianus ).
